## Context
Story: 7cf8-84fc-c5ea-48ff — sprint shared scripts accept caller-specific prefixes and PR title/body

## Goal
Add RED tests for the --prefix flag to tests/scripts/test-create-story-branch.sh and append RED marker to .test-index.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| tests/scripts/test-create-story-branch.sh | modify | n/a | n/a |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Open tests/scripts/test-create-story-branch.sh
2. Append new test cases:
   - test_create_story_branch_custom_prefix: call script with --prefix debug SESSION_BRANCH=sprint-abc123, assert output is STORY_BRANCH=debug/epic-001/story-002
   - test_create_story_branch_prefix_default: call script with no --prefix flag, assert output is STORY_BRANCH=story/<epic>/<story>
   - test_create_story_branch_prefix_anywhere: call script with --prefix as third arg (after positional args), assert output is correct
3. Append RED marker to .test-index:
   - Line: plugins/dso/scripts/create-story-branch.sh: [test_create_story_branch_custom_prefix, test_create_story_branch_prefix_default, test_create_story_branch_prefix_anywhere]

## Acceptance Criteria
- tests/scripts/test-create-story-branch.sh contains tests for --prefix flag including custom prefix, default prefix, and --prefix appearing anywhere in args
- .test-index contains RED marker for create-story-branch.sh referencing new test function names
- Running test suite: new tests FAIL (RED phase) because --prefix not yet implemented
- bash tests/run-all.sh exits non-zero but new test failures are explicitly expected (RED markers in .test-index)
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
